title: Registration Window Multiplier for Restart Change Orders — Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — how soon after resumption a restart change order is registered.**

The administration fee of a restart change order registered 7 or fewer calendar days after the engagement's resumed date is multiplied by 0.75, one registered more than 7 but no more than 30 days after it by 0.9, and any other is left unchanged.

| Calendar days from the resumed date to registration | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 0.75 |
| 8 to 30 | 0.9 |
| 31 or more | unchanged |

Boundary cases (hypothetical): registered on the resumed date itself, 0.75; on day 7, 0.75; on day 8, 0.9; on day 30, 0.9; on day 31, unchanged.
